# BouonLab — 防音ナレッジベース（Japan Soundproofing Knowledge Base）

Practical knowledge base on soundproofing, acoustic treatment, noise reduction, and quiet living in Japan.
Covers unit soundproof rooms, DIY acoustic treatment, soundproof rental apartments, financial/subsidy guides, creator environments, and market analysis.
All primary content is in Japanese; English version is currently paused.

Last updated: 2026-06-01

---

## Primary Locale

- Japanese (ja): https://bouon-lab.com/ja/ — primary content; all topics originate here

---

## URL Structure

`https://bouon-lab.com/{lang}/{category}/{slug}/` (trailing slash required)

- lang: `ja`
- category: one of 8 top-level categories listed below
- slug: article-specific identifier

---

## Content Categories (Japanese)

### 防音室 — Soundproof Room (`soundproof-room`)
Unit rooms, installation, product comparison, acoustic design, size selection, maintenance.
Index: https://bouon-lab.com/ja/soundproof-room/

### 防音賃貸 — Soundproof Rental (`soundproof-rental`)
Music-friendly apartments, contract checks, renovation ROI for landlords, market data.
Index: https://bouon-lab.com/ja/soundproof-rental/

### DIY防音 — DIY Soundproofing (`diy`)
Self-built booths, acoustic panels, bass traps, materials, cost breakdowns, failure patterns.
Index: https://bouon-lab.com/ja/diy/

### お金・補助金 — Cost & Subsidies (`money`)
Pricing, loans, subsidies (airport/road/ZEH), tax strategy, resale/ROI simulation.
Index: https://bouon-lab.com/ja/money/

### 配信・クリエイター — Creators & Streamers (`creator`)
VTuber/ASMR/gaming environments, heat management, streaming setup, rental selection.
Index: https://bouon-lab.com/ja/creator/

### 防音の基礎知識 — Acoustics Knowledge (`knowledge`)
D-value, STC, RT60, sound absorption vs insulation, noise regulations, seasonal statistics.
Index: https://bouon-lab.com/ja/knowledge/

### 地域ガイド — Local Guide (`local`)
City-specific soundproof rental guides for Tokyo, Osaka, Sendai, Kobe, Kyoto, etc.
Index: https://bouon-lab.com/ja/local/

### 企業・法人向け — Business & Enterprise (`business`)
Office soundproofing, shared studio market, ESG trends, corporate renovation strategy.
Index: https://bouon-lab.com/ja/business/

## Technical Foundation

- Framework: Astro v6 + Starlight + MDX
- Primary locale: `/ja/` (Japanese)
- URL pattern: `/ja/{category}/{slug}/` (flat, no subcategory layer)
- 8 top-level categories: soundproof-room, soundproof-rental, diy, money, creator, knowledge, local, business
- Draft articles (`draft: true`) are excluded from build and sitemap
- All articles include `lang`, `category`, `slug`, `date`, `lastmod`, `tags` in frontmatter
